title: ResAD: A Simple Framework for Class Generalizable Anomaly Detection (and ResAD++, doi:10.1007/s11263-026-02885-1)
mechanism: Learn on residual features (feature minus few-shot normal reference features) with a hypersphere constraint, so one model detects anomalies in classes never seen in training without retraining.
adaptation: Train on train-source full cells with 4 to 8 clean same-source references; at E1, references are clean half-cut pool cells of the same module family. Map used as an E1-only prior channel; compare against the bank-based residual of WeakREST.
evidence: R: class-generalizable AD across domains; MVTec AD pixel AUROC 96.9 per leaderboard summary (WebSearch, not verified in paper).
min_experiment: Offline only: residual map on H36 and val half-cut pool cells; metric half-cut crack component recall at 1% area. Kill if below the WeakREST bank map. About 5 GPU-h.
